gitspore tokens

Interface coloursStatus coloursAgent coloursTerminal, by modeTerminal palettesLogo2D plant iconsSpacingSizesRadiiBordersShadowsOpacityFonts3D scene: colours3D scene: numbersTypography

Every design value of gitspore. Penpot (gitspore_v01) is the source; apps/web/src/theme/tokens.json is its copy, scene.json holds the 3D values. Change a value in Penpot, dump it, run npm run tokens. Click any value to copy it. The Tailwind column is the utility suffix: *-button-x means px-button-x, gap-…, w-… and so on. color.muted and color.accent have no Tailwind utility because shadcn uses those names: use text-muted-foreground and bg-primary.

CSS / CSS modules
.panel {
  background: var(--color-panel);
  border-radius: var(--radius-panel);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel);
  padding: var(--space-panel-padding);
}
.title { font: var(--type-title-panel); }
Tailwind
<div className="bg-panel rounded-panel shadow-panel p-panel-padding">
  <h2 className="text-title-panel font-title">Your pots</h2>
  <button className="h-button px-button-x gap-button-gap rounded-button bg-primary text-primary-foreground">Open</button>
</div>
React Three Fiber
import { tokens } from "@/theme/tokens";
const t = tokens[mode]; // "day" | "night"
<meshStandardMaterial color={t.color.status.waiting} emissiveIntensity={t.scene.glow} />
xterm.js
import { xtermTheme, typography } from "@/theme/tokens";
const term = new Terminal({
  theme: xtermTheme[windowTerminal], // "light" | "dark", the per-window switch
  fontFamily: typography.mono.terminal.fontFamily,
  fontSize: typography.mono.terminal.fontSize,
  lineHeight: typography.mono.terminal.lineHeight,
});
Mode and per-window terminal
<html class="dark">  <!-- night, set by next-themes; no class = follow the system -->
<div class="terminal-light"> <!-- this window's terminal stays light -->
